propositions: Plan reviews must support two phases (planning and execution) with execution enforcing a fixed 0.80 priority floor, while planning retains stricter review thresholds.
Compiled state must track plan_review_phase (set by winning process_status targets: in_progress→execution, open→planning, others preserve) independently of the LLM execution_mode.
Manifest must emit phase and floor in fixed order, validate grammar atomically, parse legacy absent fields as planning, and persist phase/floor in v2 sidecar JSON for re-sign recovery.

Validity/compatibility must compare compiled current phase against signed phase/floor, accepting planning↔legacy in any compiled state and execution only when floor≥0.80, with malformed syntax as a distinct status.

All Pass-3 signing paths (normal review, drift refresh, re-sign) must capture immutable PlanReviewGeneration before LLM/probe; retry only on HEAD instability (≤3 times), refuse stale generations, and write no ticket event on model/provider failure.
Manifest restructuring, schema changes, and YAML gate wiring must ship atomically with code; rollback requires pausing compact and re-sign during downgrade to preserve v2 phase fields losslessly.
